headline: European gas turnaround delivers record netback
summary_short: Q2 2026 production 17,125 boe/d (+6% q/q, 2x y/y) on organic + 2025 acquisitions. Netback CAD $69.05/boe. Net income CAD 89M vs Q1 loss of CAD 111M.
summary_long: Tenaz Energy delivered Q2 2026 production of 17,125 boe/d, +6% q/q and more than double the prior year, despite Netherlands turnaround. Operating netback reached CAD $69.05/boe. Funds flow from operations CAD 74M, +15% q/q on higher pricing and volume. Net income CAD 89.0M swung from a CAD 111.1M loss in Q1. Net debt dropped CAD 11.2M to CAD 378.2M on positive free cash flow. Preliminary July production ~23,000 boe/d suggests continued growth as European gas assets ramp.
confidence_notes: Q1 net loss (CAD 111M) was driven by one-time acquisition/transaction charges; Q2 net income CAD 89M is closer to underlying run-rate. Netback figure is operating (pre-corporate); F&D breakdown not disclosed in the release.
